title: KID FIRING LEAVES HIS ITEM ALONE
why: With Kid firing on, player 2 taking a frag, bandage or plate out from the wheel had it used for him: taking an item out leaves the gun as the selected slot, and kid firing tested only that slot, so with a machine in range it pressed the trigger and the item in his hand took it. Proven with eval: player 2 with a machine in range took a frag out and 0.35 s later it was cooked and thrown, 3 frags down to 2, while every other trigger path already skips a held item (v26.24: an item takes a fresh pull of the trigger). Now kid firing does not fire while an item is in his hand; it still turns him toward the machine, and with nothing in his hand it shoots exactly as before.
now: With Kid firing on, a frag, bandage or plate player 2 takes out now stays in his hand until he uses it himself.
